answer.explanation: InvoiceController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with InvoiceRepository from the persistence layer. Its cancel method calls repo.markCancelled directly, so it skips the business layer (InvoiceService) and changes invoice state from the controller. FF-S03 flags this because presentation must go through business and not reach persistence directly. No docs, ADRs or comments were provided that declare an intent or grant an exception, so nothing is declared on this case.
